  1. io.parsley

Uses of Package
io.parsley

  • Classes in io.parsley used by io.parsley
    Class
    Description
    CausalBufferLimit
    Defines when records held in a causal buffer should be evicted.
    CausalBufferPolicy
    Defines what happens to a record on each type of causal violation.
    CausalBufferPolicy.Builder
    Builder for CausalBufferPolicy.
    CausalConsumer
    A high-level Kafka consumer that delivers records in causal order.
    CausalConsumers.Builder
    Builder for a CausalConsumer.
    CausalDependencies
    A producer-stamped set of causal requirements: the positions a consumer must have observed before a record stamped with these dependencies may be delivered.
    CausalDependencies.Builder
    Builder for CausalDependencies.
    CausalFrontier
    The engine/consumer horizon: the highest offset the causal processor has admitted on each topic-partition, keyed by the topic's Kafka UUID so that topic deletion and recreation produce a different identity even when the name is reused.
    CausalFrontierListener
    Callback invoked when a decorating causal processor advances its causal frontier, handed the new frontier — the highest offset the processor has admitted on each partition so far.
    CausalPosition
    A neutral coordinate in the causal log: a topic (identified by its Kafka UUID), a partition, and an offset.
    CausalProcessors.Builder
    Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier.
    CausalProcessorSupplier
    A ProcessorSupplier that wraps an ordinary user ProcessorSupplier so it runs behind Parsley's causal guarantee.
    CausalProducer
    A Kafka producer that attaches a causal dependencies header to every record it sends.
    CausalProducers.Builder
    Builder for a CausalProducer.
    CausalViolation
    A causal-ordering violation, reported to a CausalViolationHandler with enough context to act on or audit it.
    CausalViolationHandler
    Callback invoked when a decorating causal processor detects an ordering violation, handed a CausalViolation that includes the causal gap.
    CausalViolationReason
    The reason a causal ordering violation was reported.
    ViolationAction
    The action a CausalBufferPolicy takes when a causal violation occurs.
